== Chapter redlinks ==

If you could tackle stubbing those (or filling them out, but that's a much bigger task), that would be great! It'll make [[Special:Wantedpages]] useful if we don't have to sift through 400 chapter redlinks to get to the character/items. 

Take a look at anything in [[:Category:Chapter stubs]] for the format; each book has their own stub template. -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 17:37, 22 January 2009 (UTC)
:It's no rush! Like I said, if you ''want'' to tackle chapter stubbing, great; if not, we can eventually get it sorted out. But work on what you want to...
